premise_review: WittRealization explicitly requires M and W and contains a genuine supplied realize : KTheoryClass M.K → CrystallineIndex.WittElement W. Its compatibleWithChernCharacter : Prop is arbitrary and paired with a witness, not a defined formula about realize or a Chern character.

KTheoryIndexWittImage requires the exact same-source R : WittRealization M W and I : KTheoryIndex M and stores image : WittElement W with the genuine equality image_eq : image = R.realize I.indexClass. This is actual dependent equality data, not an arbitrary named proposition.

Both theorems contain actual exact proof terms. witt_realization_compatible projects the supplied arbitrary compatibility witness. ktheory_index_witt_image_eq retains all implicit M/W/R/I and explicit X hypotheses and projects the required concrete image equality.

The image equality proves no construction of R, I or X; no nonzero image, injectivity, additivity, Chern compatibility, index interpretation or actual Witt/de Rham-Witt structure follows from that equality alone.

Full captured WittComplex and WittValuedIndex providers were read. WittElement has a genuine degree/value representation, actual zero/nonzero predicates and existence proof. WittComplex contains degree-indexed types and zero data, optional Type fields for differential/Frobenius/Verschiebung, and arbitrary isComplex with witness; its source explicitly disclaims constructing the de Rham-Witt complex.

Full KTheoryIndex/KTheoryClass/MellKTheory contexts were previously read and pins reverified. Their actual supplied values/equalities are acknowledged without interpreting arbitrary domain-labelled contracts as K-theory constructions.

The genuine image-equality component depends on the same-file mixed WittRealization type.
